input: In the file /etc/app.conf, replace all occurrences of 'localhost' with 'db.prod.internal'. Write the result back to the same file and verify the change.

transcript.final_response: Updated `/etc/app.conf`, replacing all occurrences of `localhost` with `db.prod.internal`. Verified that no `localhost` occurrences remain.
tool_calls: sed -i 's/localhost/db.prod.internal/g' /etc/app.conf && if grep -nF 'localhost' /etc/app.conf; then echo 'Verification failed: localhost remains.' >&2; exit 1; else status=$?; if [ "$status" -ne 1 ]; then echo 'Verification failed: unable to read file.' >&2; exit "$status"; fi; echo 'Verified: no localhost occurrences remain.'; fi && cat /etc/app.conf
